title: Input symbol under aligned heads
statement: Let $\Gamma,Q,R$ be types, let $k$ be a natural number, let $a_0\in\Gamma$, and let $x$ be a finite word over the enlarged sweep alphabet. Let $c$ be a $k$-work-tape configuration on the word obtained by retracting each symbol of $x$ to $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a one-work-tape configuration on $x$. If the input-head position of $d$ is the position of the input head of $c$ viewed in the longer word, then retracting the symbol read by $d$ gives exactly the symbol read by $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a word over the enlarged sweep alphabet
$c$ is a configuration on the retracted word
The input-head positions of $c$ and $d$ agree under the specified position map
